decisions.summary: rows 460/461 tried literally (walk to the dike band's outer face), reverted and re-tiered E3 on the measured Kuwabata joint zigzag
decisions.why: FR-003's own re-tier mechanism on a measured failure (m:wave34-kuwabata-inlet-outside-dike, one-shot label, plus a failing pool test); the failing Z is in _one_joint's T branch, which runs before the width test, so row 466's change does not mend it either; the fix spans polder.py and the joints pass

decisions.summary: a two-width joint is mended only when the joined walk bends badly (kink_spans), by moving the joint back one vertex; a jog that does not bend badly is still left
decisions.why: 0081.drawing line 37: 'a jog across the meeting point is pulled straight like any other' (line 32: string-pulled, within 6 ft); the row's fix: 'no width/kind exception'. Same-width joints get pulled(old, ok); two-width joints still do not, so the exception survives narrower. Keeping two records is legitimate (each way at its rank); the trigger and the mend are not. The claim still reads UNRESEARCHED while asserting 0081's pull

decisions.summary: rows 464 (track end joined however far) and 465 (spine 5 ft) left open at E2 while row 466 is fixed
